Amex Schwab Platinum

Wondering what you think of Amex Schwab Platinum.

It has a whopper $695 annual fee, but a sign-up bonus of 125,000 points with $8,000 in spend.

I know the plain AMEX Platinum is offering 175,000, but here’s the difference.

If you are seeking cash, you can trade the Schwab points for 1.1 cents each to your linked brokerage account. Regular AMEX points are 0.6 cents each.

So the math:

Regular AMEX: (175,000 pts x $0.06) – $695 fee = $355 – not really worth it – $300 cash bonuses are fairly easy to find.

Schwab AMEX (125,000 pts x $0.11) = $695 fee = $680 – a very good cash back.
